task: ADM RBAC, Student Empty State, Instructor Attribution, and Progression Gating for Capstone 3 & 4

user_intent.problem: 1. Student teams could see review type checkboxes and edit instructional prompt in ADM. 2. ADM signatory block displayed 'PENDING APPOINTMENT' instead of section instructor Dr. Sales G. Aribe Jr. 3. Capstone 3 and 4 uploads were permitted prematurely before prerequisites (Cap 2 ADM approval, Ch 1-5 approvals) were satisfied.
user_intent.solution: 1. Guarded ADM review type checkboxes with canManageReviewType (!isCurrentUserStudent) and displayed student-facing empty state. 2. Resolved section instructor via teamId.sectionId.createdBy and backfilled BSIT-4A createdBy. 3. Gated Chapter 4/5 uploads behind isCap2ADMApproved and strictly locked Capstone 4 Final Paper dropzones with warning banners and Lock icons.
